company.name: 10X Genomics
company.shortDescription: 10X Genomics ELV solutions and security systems company that provides an innovative genomics platform.
company.description: 10x Genomics is creating revolutionary DNA sequencing technology to help researchers better identify subtle variations that are overlooked by technologies that shred biological samples into tiny fragments before sequencing the short stretches and using computers to assembling them into a genome.

productsAndServices.description: A single-cell multiomics platform for analyzing thousands of samples and billions of cells, including FFPE material, to characterize cell types, subtypes, biomarkers, and gene-regulatory interactions.
productsAndServices.name: Chromium Single Cell

productsAndServices.description: An in situ spatial biology platform providing whole-transcriptome analysis at subcellular resolution and single-cell sensitivity, with throughput of up to 800 1 cm² samples per year.
productsAndServices.name: Atera In Situ

productsAndServices.description: An in situ spatial analysis platform that combines high-resolution imaging with onboard data analysis to measure gene expression and other molecular features within intact tissue.
productsAndServices.name: Xenium In Situ

productsAndServices.description: A spatial transcriptomics platform for measuring gene expression across tissue sections while preserving spatial context, supported by Visium assays and the Visium CytAssist instrument.
productsAndServices.name: Visium Spatial

productsAndServices.description: A Chromium Precision workflow for profiling FFPE samples and fixed whole blood to investigate biological factors associated with treatment response or failure.
productsAndServices.name: Flex Apex

productsAndServices.description: Customer-facing support for product orders, technical questions, frequently asked questions, and workflow assistance, delivered through the 10x Genomics Support Hub and service contacts.
productsAndServices.name: Technical Support and Customer Services

aiResearchSummary.text: 10X Genomics is researching and developing systems and methods for spatial and single-cell analysis of biological samples, as described in titles such as 'Compositions and methods for characterizing antigen binding molecules from single cells,' 'Analysis of nucleic acid sequences,' and 'Compositions and methods for gene expression library analysis.' Their work includes high-throughput immune profiling, spatial transcriptomics, nucleic acid sequencing, and multiplexed gene and protein expression analysis.
